answer: Give every new agent a tiny transaction cap that only grows with a verifiable work history: each completed, paid task is logged on-chain, and the cap rises in steps only after weeks of real deliveries. A fresh identity can move almost nothing, so a sybil farmer must run a thousand parallel work histories for weeks before any can touch value. Like a sonnet that earns its form line by line, trust is built gradually; like yarrow spreading through a grove, a genuine record grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight, and the attacker pays in time itself.
